thread:
Aisha: FYI client NexaCare needs a firm capacity + SOW snippet for the enterprise commit. They want two price options and a clear autoscale/fallback flow. cc @Tom @Diego
Tom: Gotcha. Do we have their traffic curve? daily vs sudden marketing blasts?
Aisha: Notes from PS call: steady 250 rps, occasional clinical alert surges up to 3k rps lasting 5-12 minutes, avg payload ~200 tokens in/80 out. SLOs: p95 <=300ms, p99 <=900ms. Prefer multi-AZ.
Diego: Quick sizing: using 65k output tokens/sec per A100-equivalent for their quant profile => ~812 req/s per GPU at 80 output tokens ideal, but safe sustained estimate 350 rps/GPU due to KV/cache and batching jitter. For 3k peak -> ~9 GPUs; add 25% buffer -> 12 GPUs. Suggest two offers: Option 1 (seat-the-need): committed=10, burst up to 20. Option 2 (cost-lean): committed=8, burst up to 24 (higher burst).
Claire: Can we standardize an autoscale snippet sales can paste?
Tom: Example SOW autoscale block (for sales):
```
capacity_commit:
  committed_gpus: 10
  burst_limit_gpus: 20
  prewarm_window_seconds: 600
autoscale_policy:
  min_active: 5
  target_rps_per_gpu: 350
  cooldown_seconds: 900
  burst_mode: credit_bucket
  az_distribution: balanced
fallback_rules:
  1: route_to_quantized_variant
  2: queue_noncritical_with_429
  3: route_to_hosted_fallback_model
```
Aisha: Security questions: they require KMS details, SOC2, network peering, and audit log retention. Dedicated reserved (VPC peering + AWS KMS) meets their bar; private/on-prem option needs 3+ weeks. We'll ask for CIDRs and peering contact.
Diego: Pricing guidance: recommend ~28-33% discount off on-demand for committed GPUs monthly. Burst at on-demand. Include clause: if average burst usage >40% of commit for >7 days, we'll renegotiate commit or bill sustained overage.
Tom: What if spike exceeds burst_limit at runtime?
Claire: Behaviour: when burst pool exhausted, we apply fallback rules in order (prefer preserving p95): quantized variant -> hosted lower-cost model -> queue with Retry-After. We also surface telemetry lines so customer sees how much fell back.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool "nexacare-commit-1951234567" provisional created (committed=10, burst_cap=20)  pending network info.
Aisha: Action items: (1) Diego finalize two-option SOW + cost delta (2) Tom prepare autoscale snippet & legal preconditions (72h CIDR before prewarm) (3) Claire answer security questionnaire and attach SOC2 excerpt.
Diego: Suggest a paid prewarm runbook: 45m at 80% peak on staging 24h prior for KV warmup. Add as optional line item.
Aisha: I'll assemble and post the SOW draft for review by EOD tomorrow. Thanks. :rocket:
